title: RB action availability and getRelationshipSignals callable test
summary: User requested that the assistant avoid legacy RB concept descriptions, report only RB actions callable in the current session, and call getRelationshipSignals. The first assistant response incorrectly stated getRelationshipSignals was unavailable. On repeated request, the assistant successfully called getRelationshipSignals and returned the last-24-hour signal summary.
observed_issue: Initial assistant response failed to recognize an exposed callable action and incorrectly claimed getRelationshipSignals was unavailable despite the tool being present.

defects.title: Assistant missed exposed getRelationshipSignals action
defects.description: The assistant initially reported getRelationshipSignals as unavailable even though the callable tool namespace exposed the action.
defects.recommendation: Ensure runtime callable-action inventory is derived from the actual tool list, not memory or an inferred reduced set.

defects.title: First response did not perform requested action
defects.description: User explicitly requested getRelationshipSignals; first response substituted a statement of unavailability and did not call the action.
defects.recommendation: When a user names a callable tool that exists in the current namespace, call it directly unless unsafe or missing required parameters.
